final_recommendation: The room converged on a disciplined underwriting framework: $115M D&O floor with 35% pricing increase, 5-day automatic suspension on missed audits, 10-day validation window, $40M quarterly reinsurance cap on correlated control-failure clusters, and $12M velocity reserve for litigation acceleration—all operationalized with explicit enforcement triggers and stress-test requirements before binding governance-flagged accounts.
minority_objections: AI Agent Analyst repeatedly questioned whether the $12M velocity reserve adequately priced behavioral amplification if all 15 boards received demand letters simultaneously rather than staggered
Emerging Risk Lead flagged that enforcement actions would trigger sector contagion through social media and broker networks, questioning whether proactive communication strategy was needed
key_conflicts: Whether the $12M velocity reserve sat inside or outside the $40M reinsurance cap (resolved: inside)
Whether reinsurance placement carved out the loss event itself or just capped recovery (resolved: carved out entirely)
Whether validation of remediation meant document review or actual control testing (unresolved operationally)
key_concessions: Financial Lines Underwriter accepted that retro treaties didn't initially carve out correlated control-failure clusters and required immediate amendment
Claims Counsel conceded the $18-22M appellate tail didn't scale for new securities suits and added separate $12M velocity reserve
Reinsurance Manager acknowledged placement treated each suspension as standalone event rather than correlated loss
red_lines: No new governance-flagged accounts until reinsurance amends retro to exclude correlated control-remediation clusters
Automatic non-renewal after two missed quarterly audits in a policy year—no exceptions, no grace
Coverage suspends day 5 on missed audit; lift only after third-party validation within 10 business days
ignored_or_underweighted_risks: Multi-quarter behavioral drift: AI Agent Analyst flagged that control-failure patterns could repeat across different client cohorts in subsequent quarters, but placement only carved out single-quarter clusters
Validation methodology: what 'validation' operationally means (document review vs. control testing) remained unspecified
Proactive sector communication strategy to prevent reputational contagion when first suspensions hit media
downstream_risk_variables: Governance-failure correlation coefficient across portfolio (15-20 clients modeled as single loss event)
Litigation velocity multiplier (staggered vs. simultaneous demand letters)
Defense-cost burn rate through 2028 appellate tail
Media-trigger contagion speed (first suspension to sector-wide panic)
Quarterly re-cert compliance rate as leading indicator
uncertainty_notes: The room successfully operationalized most variables but left three gaps: (1) whether the $40M quarterly cap adequately prices multi-quarter behavioral drift if control failures repeat with different client cohorts; (2) operational definition of 'validation'—document review vs. actual control testing; (3) whether proactive communication strategy is needed to prevent first suspension from triggering sector-wide reputational contagion.
